name: claude-simple
description: A lean, measurement-first Claude Code setup for any stack: role-based agents, path-triggered rule packs per language, framework, ORM and database, and the project's memory kept in the repository.

plugins.name: simple
plugins.description: A language-agnostic Claude Code setup: five role-based agents each pinned to the right model, 49 path-triggered rule packs covering 17 languages, 6 front-end frameworks, 16 ORMs, 5 databases and the infrastructure around them, a project memory vault you can open in Obsidian, two hooks, a cost statusline, and the method for measuring a plugin before adopting it.
